dict.string: Notch reads the current track and controls playback in Spotify or Apple Music. Only used by the music tile you turn on.
Notch shows your next calendar event in the notch. Only used by the calendar tile you turn on.
Notch shows Bluetooth state in the quick controls tile. Only used when that tile is on.
Notch shows whether Do Not Disturb is on, so it can show a peek when Focus turns on or off. Without this permission the app only says that Focus status is unavailable.
